compiled:
📰 General

Teen Threatening D4vd’s Career Led to Fatal Argument, Texts Reveal •

Text messages released during a preliminary hearing reveal that Celeste Rivas Hernandez threatened to damage D4vd’s career in the days leading up to his arrest for the death of the teenager. The threats stemmed from an argument regarding a relationship, according to court documents. Investigators allege that D4vd and Rivas Hernandez engaged in a physical altercation that resulted in the teenager’s death. The preliminary hearing is ongoing, with further evidence expected to be presented.

🌍 World

New York Times Intensifies Scrutiny of Trump’s Alleged “Bribe Plane” Investigation •

The New York Times continues to aggressively investigate Donald Trump’s private jet, now referred to as the “bribe plane,” following its acquisition by the Trump Organization. The investigation centers around the timing of the purchase and the potential connection to a previously undisclosed loan. The Times’ persistent reporting has prompted renewed attention from authorities and legal experts regarding the financial transactions surrounding the aircraft. Investigators are examining the circumstances of the sale and its implications for potential legal challenges.

🦅 US

Commanders Fire Tight Ends Coach Ben Steele Following DWI Arrest •

The Washington Commanders terminated the contract of tight ends coach Ben Steele on Monday following his arrest for driving while intoxicated. The team announced the decision in a brief statement, citing the circumstances surrounding the arrest. Steele was taken into custody on Sunday after police responded to a call regarding a vehicle obstructing the roadway. The Commanders will begin training camp this week and have not provided further details regarding the coaching staff’s future.

💰 Business

Maple Leaf Foods Recalls Over 12,000 Pounds of Imported Bacon Due to Import Violation •

Maple Leaf Foods initiated a recall of over 12,000 pounds of bacon products imported from Canada. The Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) determined the recall stemmed from an import violation. The affected bacon was distributed across multiple states within the United States. Consumers are advised to check product labels and discard any recalled items. The FSIS is investigating the specific nature of the import violation.

💻 Technology

Apple Releases Massive Security Update Addressing Over 225 Vulnerabilities Across iOS and macOS •

Apple has released iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6, alongside updates for macOS, containing a significant number of security fixes. The update addresses over 75 vulnerabilities specifically impacting iPhones and 150+ issues affecting macOS devices. These fixes target a range of issues, including those related to data protection and system stability. Users are advised to install the update promptly to enhance their device’s security posture.

🎭 Entertainment

Eric Roberts Reveals Reason for Missing Emma Roberts’ Wedding

Eric Roberts explained his absence from his daughter Emma Roberts’ wedding to Cody John. The actor, who shares Emma with ex-partner Kelly Cunningham, addressed the reason for his non-attendance. Roberts stated he was unable to travel to Idaho for the ceremony due to a prior commitment. He confirmed the wedding took place as planned, with Emma and Cody celebrating their marriage.

🏅 Sports

Tony Romo Cited for Refusing Intoxication Test Following OWI Arrest •

Former Dallas Cowboys quarterback Tony Romo has been issued a citation for refusing a chemical test following his arrest in Wisconsin last week. Court records indicate Romo was taken into custody after police responded to a traffic stop. The citation stems from his refusal to submit to a test for intoxication. Authorities are currently pursuing charges related to the incident.

🔬 Science

Dead SpaceX Rocket Set for Dramatic Collision With the Moon’s Surface •

A defunct SpaceX rocket, launched in 2023, is currently traveling through space and is predicted to impact the Moon. The rocket, a five-story section of a previously used booster, has been orbiting Earth for over a year without a controlled trajectory. Scientists anticipate the collision will occur on August 5, 2026, near the Einstein Crater. The impact is expected to generate a significant amount of debris and dust on the lunar surface.

🩺 Health

COVID-19 Cases Rising: California Reports Summer Uptick in Virus Activity •

A recent increase in COVID-19 cases is being observed across California and parts of the Western and Southern United States. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention indicates this rise represents a potential seasonal uptick in virus activity. Initial data suggests the summer months may be triggering a resurgence of the virus. Health officials are monitoring the situation closely, tracking hospitalizations and variant spread as they continue to investigate the cause of the increase.
